from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException
import pandas as pd
import pandera as pa
from pandera.typing import Series
import io

class TransactionSchema(pa.DataFrameModel):
    transaction_date: Series[str] = pa.Field(coerce=True)
    account_code: Series[str] = pa.Field(str_matches=r"^\d{4}$")
    amount: Series[float] = pa.Field(ge=0.01)
    description: Series[str] = pa.Field(str_length={"min_value": 3, "max_value": 255})

router = APIRouter(prefix="/accounting/ledgers")

@router.post("/{ledger_id}/import-csv")
async def import_ledger_transactions(
    ledger_id: str,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    ledger_service: LedgerService = Depends(get_ledger_service),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    ledger = await ledger_service.get_ledger(ledger_id)
    if not ledger:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Ledger not found")
    if ledger.organization_id != current_user.organization_id and not current_user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user lacks permission to modify this accounting ledger")

    content = await file.read()
    df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(content))
    try:
        validated_df = TransactionSchema.validate(df)
    except pa.errors.SchemaError as err:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"Data validation failed: {err}")

    inserted_count = await ledger_service.append_validated_records(ledger_id, validated_df)
    return {"status": "imported", "ledger_id": ledger_id, "records_added": inserted_count}
